title: TagPhotoV1
description: Proposed association describing what a logical image asset means to one NFC tag. This schema is not yet canonical.

assetId.description: Identifier of an ImageAssetV1 entry in the containing registry assets collection. Referential integrity is enforced at the registry/application layer.

purpose.description: Application-defined semantic role of this photo for the tag, such as primary, detail, label, or context.

caption.description: Optional human-readable caption specific to this tag-photo association.
